name: @empire-t/api-client
description: Typed client for the Empire T REST API, generated from apps/api's OpenAPI schema

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript openapi.yaml | prettier --stdin-filepath src/schema.d.ts > src/schema.generated.tmp && mv src/schema.generated.tmp src/schema.d.ts
scripts.check-generated: openapi-typescript openapi.yaml | prettier --stdin-filepath src/schema.d.ts | diff -q - src/schema.d.ts
